name: Kaida Fabrication Multi-Tool Wristband
description:
A heavy wristband with integrated fold-out tools — wire cutters, a flat-head driver, a bottle opener, a glass breaker, and a 5cm serrated blade. The tools nest flush into the band's surface and are invisible when stowed. The band itself is brushed titanium over a comfort liner.

Carried by mechanics, maintenance workers, and anyone who finds themselves regularly needing tools they don't have. The wristband's low profile means it passes most security checkpoints as jewelry — the serrated blade is the reason some checkpoints have upgraded their scanners.
functionality: Integrated multi-tool, covert blade, daily-carry utility
what_it_says: You solve small problems with your wrist and you've occasionally solved bigger problems with that blade.
story_hooks: A security checkpoint confiscates a Multi-Tool Wristband and discovers the serrated blade has been replaced with something that looks identical but is made from a material hard enough to cut through reinforced glass.
